name: harness
description: Goal-driven multi-agent development harness: 12 role agents, 8 workflow commands (GOAL->analyze->plan->build->verify->retro, plus a lightweight quick path), file-based state (.harness/), self-improving retro loop. Covers Java/Spring Boot backend, React/TS frontend, Python LLM-agent development, data pipelines, and GCP MLOps.
